description: This file defines the Swagger/OpenAPI specification for the 'Services.Local.VPN.GRE.Tunnel' API, including endpoints, responses, schemas, and events related to managing GRE Tunnels.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.GRE.Tunnel.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters of the GRE Tunnel, including operational status, interfaces, remote address, statistics, and various response codes.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.GRE.Tunnel.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters (bytes and frames transmitted/received) for the GRE Tunnel.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.GRE.Tunnel.Set
methods.description: Modifies the administrative status and configuration parameters of the GRE Tunnel, such as enabling/disabling, interfaces, and remote address.
